reviews.title: Quiet!
reviews.comment: I am a massive fan (no pun intended) of these fans. I am using 5 of them (all as in-take); these are quiet up until 40% power and move a good amount of air.  They fit any traditional 140mm spots. The ARGB can be daisy chained out of the box; the power is a single 4 pin PWM connector. These are among the only case fans that do not exhibit the oscillating "hum" that is prevalent in other case fans. The ARGB is strong and vibrant.  If you like little to no noise coming from your PC outside of your CPU fan, these are the play.
reviews.author: Daniel Krause

reviews.title: Quiet with satisfactory lighting
reviews.comment: Does what it says on the box; it's a quiet fan w/ RGB and standard cables. It's a little dated by today's standards of snap together fans with mirror stickers and side LEDs, but these still look great and more importantly are *quiet*. When I spin them up to 100% the primary noise is the sound of air moving, not of the fan whining at me. I use Lightwings and Lightwings LX in two computers, and at this point I'm not even going to look at other brands, I've always been disappointed and just end up ordering Be Quiet in the end. Pretty standard installation ease, just requires zip ties to handle all the excess cabling and a PWM splitter if you want to link 2+ together.
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.title: Amazing performance and value
reviews.comment: Bought these to build my wife's computer for her birthday. After a year, they're still running strong and the colors are vibrant. Keeps my wife's gaming rig cool even on hot days here in Texas. Installation was a breeze. be quiet makes great products.
